decisions.reason: The cloud contact centre service fits the firm's strategic shift toward cloud and business services, and the slack of a large telecom firm lets it carry the product while early results are still uncertain, even though its brief website mention signals lower visibility.

The call number routing platform builds on the firm's core network competence and already has its own dedicated web page, so with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search or withdrawal.
